result.instructions: Groundlane is the required web research and public-page retrieval layer. Use web_search to find candidate sources, web_fetch to read a page, and web_extract for deterministic selector or bounded pattern extraction. Use parse when a caller needs document, metadata, link, media, or table structures. These tools may be deferred in clients; inspect the complete callable tool inventory before reporting Groundlane unavailable. Do not substitute legacy fetch or browser scraping tools when Groundlane is required.
